name: Leon
source:
Likes: Rich Nature: Forest, Spring
Dislikes: None
Hobby: None
Skill: Light Magic

"Your smile is my light...can I look at you little more?"

Vincent: I heard this guy has lost his memory.
If I were to describe him in one word, it would be "mystifying"...
He keeps his silence most of the time, but once a class starts he surprises everybody by showing his astonishing powerful magic. Plus he does it like it is nothing difficult...
I mean he is beyond talented and that scares me!
Hmm...He is something...
That's for sure.

[Official in-game description]
